doc: NUMPY ARTIFACT: fftfreq(14) * 14 gives 4.999999999999999 for k = 5 (it is computed as (i * (1/14)) * 14, not an exact integer), so the modes (+-5, 0) and (0, +-5) have radius just BELOW low = 5.0 and are dropped, where an exact-integer k would keep them. Power-of-two sizes (every size the product uses) are exact and unaffected; a port that wants this case computes k as (i as f64 * (1.0 / n as f64)) * n as f64, i in 0..n/2 then -n/2..-1. The white noise the seed draws is the input plan0.white (size, size). FFT convention: numpy fft2 unnormalized forward, ifft2 divides by size^2, k = fftfreq(size) * size. Measured: the spread under nudges is the same as the other fBm cases (max |diff| 1e-15); the artifact itself moves the output by 0.11 (max |diff|; 123 of 196 modes are kept, 127 with an exact k), so the case does tell the two apart.
